shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "---" && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && echo "---" && git status --short

cat package.json && echo "--- tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "--- vite" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "--- index.html" && cat index.html && echo "--- src" && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- src files" && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done && echo "--- installed gravity" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; do echo "$p: $(node -p "require('./$p').version")"; done

grep -n -A12 "^## Navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40; echo "--- npm view"; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo "--- inspect"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
 ' | tr ',' '
' | grep -E '^"7\.' | tail -5; echo "--- peers of latest 7.x"; V=$(npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
 ' | tr ',' '
' | grep -E '^"7\.' | tail -1 | tr -d '"'); echo "V=$V"; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@$V peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @bem-react/classname@^1.6.0 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "--- versions"; for p in @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname; do echo "$p: $(node -p "require('./node_modules/$p/package.json').version")"; done; echo "--- package.json"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').dependencies,null,2)"

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && echo "=== README required setup" && rg -n -i -C 4 "required setup|import '@gravity-ui/navigation|styles.css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -60; echo "=== uikit docs"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch Text Button Icon >/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader; echo "=== navigation files"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== README required setup"; rg -n -i -C 4 "required setup|styles|ThemeProvider|import " node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -60

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/ | head -30; rg -n -C 3 "AsideHeader" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -40; echo "=== d.ts"; rg -n "menuItems|onItemClick|current\?|renderContent|logo\?|compact\?|onChangeCompact|export type MenuItem|interface MenuItem|export interface AsideHeaderProps|export type AsideHeaderProps|hideCollapseButton|headerDecoration|rootClassName|topAlert|subheader|footerItems" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/ 2>/dev/null
sed -n 1,160p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts

cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components && rg -n -A12 "export interface MenuItem\b|export interface LogoProps|export type RenderContentType" types.d.ts Content/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=== uikit ThemeProvider d.ts"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "theme\?|scoped|export declare const ThemeProvider|export declare function ThemeProvider|useThemeValue|useTheme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== Switch"; cat $U/components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40 || rg -l "Switch" $U/components --glob '*.d.ts' | head; echo "=== Card"; rg -n -A3 "export interface CardProps|type?:|view?:|size?:" $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== Theme type"; rg -n "export type Theme\b|export type Theme =" $U/components/theme/types.d.ts; echo "=== icons"; for n in House Gear Moon Sun Bolt; do printf "%s: " $n; rg -l "export \{[^}]*\b$n\b|\b$n\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head;

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; SW=$(rg -l "export declare const Switch|interface SwitchProps" $U --glob '*.d.ts' | head -1); echo "switch file: $SW"; cat "$SW" | head -40; echo "=== icons exist?"; for n in House Gear Moon Sun Bolt Check Plus Circle ListUl; do if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$n.js ]; then echo "$n: yes"; else echo "$n: $(ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -i -x "$n.js" || echo NO)"; fi; done; echo "=== card type/view values"; rg -n "CardType =|CardView =|CardSize =" $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts

rg -n -A10 "export interface ControlProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n "ButtonView =|export type ButtonView" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -8; echo "=== Flex/Text"; rg -n "export type TextVariant|variant\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n -A12 "export type TextVariant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -20

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; F=$(rg -l "export declare const Flex|export interface FlexProps" $U --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3); echo "$F"; rg -n "wrap|direction|justifyContent|alignItems|gap" $U/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== TextInput"; rg -n "value|onUpdate|placeholder|onKeyDown|size|view" $U/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== Checkbox"; rg -n "content|checked|onUpdate|size" $U/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -8; echo "=== IconData export"; rg -n "IconData|export.*IconProps" $U/components/Icon/*.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== icons"; for n in TrashBin Plus Check; do [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$n.js ] && echo "$n yes" || echo "$n NO"; done

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; rg -n "wrap|direction|justifyContent|alignItems|gap" $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -10; echo "=== TextInput"; TI=$(rg -l "export interface TextInputProps" $U --glob '*.d.ts' | head -1); echo $TI; rg -n "value|onUpdate|placeholder|onKeyDown|size\?|view\?" $TI | head -12; echo "=== Checkbox checked"; rg -n "checked|onUpdate|ControlProps" $U/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== Text export"; rg -n "variant" $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -4; rg -n "header-1|subheader-1|body-1" $U/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -5

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; TI=$(ls $U/components/controls/TextInput/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $U -name "TextInput*.d.ts" | head -3); echo "$TI"; for f in $TI; do rg -n "value|onUpdate|placeholder|onKeyDown|size\?|view\?|Props" $f | head -15; done
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -60

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; rg -n -i "width" $U/types.d.ts $U/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head; echo "---"; rg -n -i "width" $U/TextInput/TextInput.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; ls $U/TextInput/ | head -20; rg -n -o "\.g-text-input\b[^{]*\{[^}]*\}" $U/TextInput/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "width" $U/TextInput/TextInput.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "width" $U/TextInput/TextInput.module.scss.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls $U/TextInput/*.scss 2>/dev/null; cat $U/TextInput/TextInput.css 2>/dev/null | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
cat .gitignore; echo "---"; git status --short; echo "--- diff of deps"; git diff --stat 2>/dev/null | tail -2
rm -rf dist && git diff package.json && git status --short
